# config

Configure environment display settings (label, type, color)

## Usage

```
ppds env config [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | yes | Environment URL to configure |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--color` | `-c` | `EnvironmentColor?` |  | Status bar color. Valid values: Red, Green, Yellow, Cyan, Blue, Gray, Brown, BrightRed, BrightGreen, BrightYellow, BrightCyan, BrightBlue, White |
| `--label` | `-l` | `string` |  | Short display label for status bar and tabs |
| `--list` |  | `bool` |  | List all configured environments |
| `--remove` |  | `bool` |  | Remove configuration for the environment |
| `--show` | `-s` | `bool` |  | Show current configuration for the environment |
| `--type` | `-t` | `EnvironmentType?` |  | Environment type (Production, Sandbox, Development, Test, Trial) |
